साउथ और बॉलीवुड सिनेमा प्रेमियों के लिए आई है एक बड़ी और धमाकेदार खबर! 💥

सुपरहिट फिल्म के सीक्वल Hanu-Man 2 The Rise of Vanaras का आधिकारिक ऐलान कर दिया गया है। 🎬
निर्माताओं ने इस सीक्वल में मुख्य भूमिका निभाने के लिए Panja Vaisshnav Tej के नाम की घोषणा की है। 🔥
इस बड़े ऐलान के बाद सोशल मीडिया पर यह सवाल तेजी से उठ रहा है कि क्या नए एक्टर ने Teja Sajja को रिप्लेस कर दिया है? 🤔
फिल्म के सीक्वल को लेकर दर्शकों के बीच भारी उत्सुकता और बज बना हुआ है। 🚀

आपको क्या लगता है, क्या Panja Vaisshnav Tej इस रोल में Teja Sajja को टक्कर दे पाएंगे? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Hanu-Man 2 The Rise of Vanaras: Panja Vaisshnav Tej announced to lead sequel; Did the actor replace Teja Sajja?
ctx.summary:
The makers of  Hanu-Man  have announced a new fantasy venture titled Hanu-Man 2: The Rise of Vanaras, featuring Panja Vaisshnav Tej in the lead role. The announcement has sparked buzz, especially as Teja Sajja headlined the original film. 
 Hanu-Man 2: The Rise of Vanaras announced 
 The announcement poster offers a glimpse into the ambitious fantasy world, featuring a man rising through the clouds against a striking divine backdrop. Sharing the announcement, the production house wrote, “What began with a dream continues with an even bigger vision. Proud to take the legacy of #HanuMan forward with our next ambitious venture. Presenting #HanuMan2 – THE RISE OF VANARAS. Looking forward to this exciting collaboration with @panja_vaishnav_tej and the visionary @vi_anand as we set out to create something truly spectacular. More updates soon.” 
   The announcement comes amid reports of a fallout between Hanu-Man producer K Niranjan Reddy and director Prasanth Varma. While the latter has joined hands with Mythri Movie Makers to develop Jai Hanuman, featuring Rishab Shetty, Niranjan Reddy is moving ahead with a separate project. The latest announcement has consequently raised questions about whether Panja Vaisshnav Tej's film is connected to the original franchise and if  Teja Sajja  has been replaced. However, the makers have not clarified about their relation with Jai Hanuman.
